title: run_cloud_test's fake hold feed line does not reproduce the real run_held reason prefix
body: TestRunCloudEndsHoldingForTriageAndTriageSettlesIt hand-crafts its run_held detail as prose ('the close-out does not hand over...') instead of the real reason-first shape the reconciler writes ('finding_untriaged: <message>'), so the watch's triage-verb branch is never exercised end-to-end on the cloud path — the test passes through the settle branch with prose that merely mentions triage. The local path covers the branch (TestWatchHoldAlertNamesTriageForAFindingHold); the fake should reproduce the real shape.
